title: Native protein purification of ferroxidase LPR1 from leaf extracts of a transgenic Arabidopsis thaliana line
protocol: Vortex 15 g frozen plant material in a 50 mL Falcon tube with 40 mL pre-cooled extraction buffer for a minimum of 1 min.
Incubate the vortexed suspension on ice for 5 min.
Vortex the suspension again for 1 min.
Incubate the suspension at 4°C for a minimum of 30 min on a rotating wheel or shaker.
Centrifuge the mixture at 500 × g for 30 min at 4°C.
Discard the pellet and filter the supernatant through a nylon mesh with a 100 μm mesh size to remove residual plant fragments.
Work at 4°C on ice and store protein preparations on ice when transported.

Add 10.56 g of (NH4)2SO4 to 40 mL supernatant in a beaker glass with magnetic stirrer, stirring moderately and adding in aliquots of approximately 2 g each time, ensuring the ammonium sulfate is completely dissolved before adding more.
Stir the solution for one hour at 4°C on ice.
Centrifuge the solution at 4,500 × g for 45 minutes at 4°C (precooled).
Transfer the supernatant to a fresh beaker glass with magnetic stirrer and solubilize the greenish pellet in extraction buffer.
Take 40 μL of the sample for Western blot analysis; this sample is referred to as “pellet 1 (P1)”.
Discard the rest of the pellet and continue working with the supernatant from the previous precipitation reaction.
Slowly add another 10.56 g of (NH4)2SO4 to the supernatant while stirring moderately, adding in aliquots of approximately 2 g each time and ensuring complete dissolution before adding more.
Stir the solution for one hour at 4°C on ice.
Centrifuge (4,500 × g) for 45 minutes at 4°C.
Discard supernatant and take 40 μL for Western blot analysis.
Solubilize pellet in 2 mL extraction buffer.
Take 5 μL of solubilized sample for Western blot analysis.
Thaw protein pellet on ice and centrifuge (>15,000 × g) for 20 minutes at 4°C to clear precipitates.
Attach a HighLoad Superdex 200 gel filtration column (HL 16/60, GE Healthcare) to an FPLC-system.
Wash the sample loop with 5 mL water followed by 5 mL NaOH (1 M), then with 5 mL water and 10 mL Buffer A.
Equilibrate the column with 2 column volumes of Buffer A at 1 mL/min flow rate or according to manufacturer’s instructions before loading the sample.
Load protein sample using a 5 mL loop onto the equilibrated column.
Elute proteins from the column at 0.5 mL/min flow rate with Buffer A.
Start sampling 1 mL fractions after 20% of the column volume has passed through the column.
Combine fractions corresponding to the “F3” in Figure 2A (in our system fraction E4-F4).
Dilute the combined fractions with 10–20 mL Na2HPO4-NaH2PO4 (0.02 M, pH 7) to a final volume of 25–30 mL.
Take 40 μL sample for Western blot analysis.
Label the sample as “size exclusion (SE)”.
Attach a carboxymethyl-sepharose column to the FLPC-system and equilibrate it with 10 mL Buffer B.
Load the sample at 0.5 mL/min.
Continue to run Buffer B at 1 mL/min through the system until the baseline returns to zero.
Wash the column with 10 mL of Buffer B at 1 mL/min flow rate.
Elute the bound proteins with Buffer B and increasing concentrations of Buffer C up to 100% Buffer C at 1 mL/min flow rate.
Collect 1 mL fractions during elution.
Analyze the fractions by SDS-PAGE.
Use the desired fractions from analysis.
Thaw the frozen samples collected at different purification steps.
Add 10 μL 5× SDS loading buffer to 40 μL sample.
Incubate for 5 min at 95°C.
Run the samples on an SDS-PAGE gel.
Assemble the chamber with the gel according to the manufacturer’s instructions.
Fill up the chamber with SDS Running Buffer.
Load 45 μL of each sample in each well of the gel, including the protein ladder (5 μL pre-stained 1 kb protein ladder).
Run the gel at 85 volts for 15 minutes.
Run the gel at 130 volts for another 45 minutes.
Transfer the protein bands from the gel to a PVDF blotting membrane using a PowerBlotter system.
Block the membrane with 5% (w/v) dry milk in TBST for 1 hour at 22°C–25°C or 12 hours at 4°C.
Incubate with primary epitope-specific anti-LPR1 polyclonal antibody (1:1,000 in TBST with 3% dry milk) for 1 hour at 22°C–25°C or 12 hours at 4°C.
Wash the membrane 3 × 10 minutes with TBST.
Incubate the membrane with a suitable horseradish peroxidase (HRP)-conjugated secondary antibody (1:5,000 in TBST with 3% dry milk) for 1 hour at 22°C–25°C or 12 hours at 4°C.
Wash the membrane 5 × 10 minutes with TBST.
Add ECL Select Western Blotting Detection Reagent to the membrane following the manufacturer’s protocol.
Analyze chemiluminescence with X-ray films (incubation time 2–10 minutes).
Stain PVDF membrane with Coomassie for 5 minutes.
Prepare acetate-buffer in 1.5 mL tubes, ensuring at least 3 technical replicates per sample are prepared.
Add 1 μg total protein to the tube containing acetate-buffer.
Incubate the reaction mixture with substrate-solution by adding 84 μL and inverting twice.
Transfer 200 μL of the reaction mixture into a well containing ferrozine solution immediately after mixing (time point "0").
Place the remaining reaction tubes in an incubator at 25°C for further sampling points.
Take samples from the reaction mixture at time points 2, 5, 7, 10, and 15 minutes post-substrate addition.
Measure absorbance of each well at 560 nm in a microplate reader.
Calculate ΔE based on the formula y = ΔA_t x + n.
Determine the diameter of the well plate or cuvette used to measure absorbance, d = 0.52 cm.
Use the extinction coefficient, ϵ = 0.0254 L/μmol*cm.
Calculate Δc using |ΔE| / (d * ϵ).
Compute Δn by multiplying Δc with the reaction volume V.
Determine specific enzyme activity A_spec based on the formula Δn / (m Protein * 60).
